title: The first jet airliner kept falling apart
caption:
Three Comets broke up in the air in less than a year. Engineers sank a whole fuselage in a water tank to find out why. 💥

Would you have flown on one in 1954?
sources: Wikipedia, de Havilland Comet (Calcutta May 1953, Elba January 1954, Naples April 1954; Farnborough water-tank test)
